pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:306 A run is opened durably with a run.start audit row, but runs live only in the in-memory `runs` map and nothing at startup closes a run.start that has no run.finish, and RunState (Starting/Running/Clean/Failed/Cancelled) has no indeterminate status, so a process death leaves a permanently open run in the record instead of an indeterminate closure.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:306 The only writer of run.finish is finish_run_because (engines.rs:481), and it is reached only from live actor messages or cancel_runs. A search of crates/ found no recovery sweep that closes an unmatched run.start after a crash, and the RunState enum has no unknown or indeterminate value.

crates/table-runtime/src/dispatcher.rs:598 Through IPC, the service-writable tier can only select a closed EngineId that was already attached at startup. Executables are resolved only from the process PATH in attach_native_engines. One engine whose workspace fails is skipped in its own lane (engines.rs:132) and does not stop the host.

crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:292 The MCP capability is minted per run from that run's scope (deal, role, category), not from an environment variable. agent_gate then re-checks the same scope and the mandate on every intent at engines.rs:429-444.

crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:400 There is no hook chain or extension surface here, which is the technique's below-threshold case, and the code keeps the sentence the technique asks for. The gate audits its own refusals before returning, so refused calls are not missing from the ledger.
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:271 Every run gets its own id at creation, and no run launches another; a search for subagent found nothing.
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:256 A run's whole input is computed once at start_agent. There is no channel for a person's follow-up to reach a live run.
crates/table-runtime/src/engines.rs:1 No long-running remote operation is exposed to the agent loop. Unknown PayPal outcomes are resolved by the money pipeline (table-app), outside any run.

pairs.registryProposal: indeterminate-closure-on-interruption assumes a recovery sweep that writes the wrong status. It does not name the case where no sweep exists at all: an in-memory-only run registry whose durable start row is never closed. That case is common in desktop hosts and is worth stating as its own failure mode.
